_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "pinned_at" TEXT NULL, "is_collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_collapsed" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "folder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES folders (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TASK', "view_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'list', "show_in_smart_lists" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_in_smart_lists" IN (0, 1)), "pinned_at" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sortOrder', "sort_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sortOrder', "show_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_completed" IN (0, 1)), "show_details" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_details" IN (0, 1)), "date_as_countdown" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("date_as_countdown" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lists (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lists (id), "section_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sections (id), "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TEXT', "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "is_all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_all_day" IN (0, 1)), "time_zone" TEXT NULL, "is_floating" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_floating" IN (0, 1)), "pinned_at" TEXT NULL, "progress" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repeat_rule" TEXT NULL, "repeat_from" TEXT NULL, "snooze_until" TEXT NULL, "estimated_pomos" INTEGER NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "checklist_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "is_all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_all_day" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "color" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "pinned_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_tags" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "tag_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_reminders" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "trigger"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TEXT', "items" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "tag_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "body" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "countdowns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'countdown', "count_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', "ignore_year" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ignore_year" IN (0, 1)), "show_age" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_age" IN (0, 1)), "reminders" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "repeat_rule" TEXT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'onTheDay', "style" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "pinned_at" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "icon_color" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "count_up" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("count_up" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pomo', "task_id" TEXT NULL, "timer_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "motto" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "color" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily', "weekdays" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "every_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'checkIn', "goal_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "check_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "step" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_days" INTEGER NULL, "section" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'others', "reminders" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "auto_show_log" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_show_log" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_checkins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id), "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "mark" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "mood" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "filters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "pinned_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "color" TEXT NULL, "monthly_limit" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "closing_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credit_limit" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_recurrings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_categories (id), "card_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_cards (id), "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "month" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "remind_days_before" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_categories (id), "card_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_cards (id), "invoice_month" TEXT NULL, "installment_group" TEXT NULL, "installment_index" INTEGER NULL, "installment_count" INTEGER NULL, "recurring_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_recurrings (id), "recurring_due" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_card_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fin_cards (id), "invoice_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "borrower" TEXT NOT NULL, "principal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lent_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "remind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loan_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "loan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES loans (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diet_foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein" REAL NULL, "carbs" REAL NULL, "fat" REAL NULL, "fiber" REAL NULL, "measure_name" TEXT NULL, "measure_grams" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diet_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "measure_name" TEXT NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein" REAL NULL, "carbs" REAL NULL, "fat" REAL NULL, "fiber" REAL NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
